complexity.notes: Sorting is unnecessary since the input is guaranteed sorted, and the nums2 copy makes the solution O(n) extra space, violating the problem's O(1) space requirement. The repeated O(n) index() calls and pop() add linear overhead and convoluted duplicate handling; a plain two-pointer on the original array with offset +1 indices would be simpler, O(n) time, and O(1) space.
complexity.summary: Copies and sorts the array, then runs a two-pointer scan to find the pair summing to target, and finally recovers original 1-indexed positions via linear index() searches (with a special case when both values coincide at the same first index).
